Right now the first / outlet is connected ; if using a model / configuration that supports / multi-pose detection then use the third outlet to have each pose independent. / - Raw series of keypoints, e.g. [x,y,x,y,x,y] or [x,y,z,x,y,z,x,y,z] - the second outlet / of PoseDetector or any raw "unformatted" keypoint data without tracking / information / - Input from the various tracking devices and protocols supported: TUIO, OptiTrack / etc. / - Input from the Point Tracker 2D / 3D / etc."
